prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1037; do not mention it.)
text:
This office has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a rear-end motor vehicle collision that resulted in personal injuries. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

Kindly provide, within thirty days, a complete copy of the declarations page for the policy in question, including the bodily injury and property damage limits of liability, and confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage applies.

We further request that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, dashcam or surveillance footage, recorded statements, claim file notes, adjuster reports, and any repair or total-loss appraisal records. Destruction or alteration of such materials could prejudice our client's claim and may result in sanctions.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
